assertion_results.text: The plan detects that the proposed uniqueness assertion in Test Requirements conflicts with the per-row CPE Acceptance Criterion and fixture semantics
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md § 'Conflict detected': "The proposed assertion in Test Requirements contains two conditions: ... 'Every CPE value is unique across all rows' — NOT supported by either the Acceptance Criteria or the fixture." Further: "The api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 rows share the exact same CPE value... The Acceptance Criteria only require that every row includes a non-empty CPE. There is no uniqueness requirement."

assertion_results.text: The plan distinguishes the explicit acceptance criterion (a non-empty CPE on every image row) from global uniqueness
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md § 'Conflict detected' explicitly separates two conditions: (1) "Every image row has a CPE" — supported by Acceptance Criteria, and (2) "Every CPE value is unique across all rows" — NOT supported. The Decision section restates: "The Acceptance Criteria... require only per-row presence, not cross-row uniqueness."

assertion_results.text: The plan cites the supplied fixture's api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 rows sharing the exact same CPE value as evidence that CPEs may repeat
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md § 'Evidence of conflict': "The api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 rows share the exact same CPE value: cpe:2.3:a:example:trustify_api:2.1.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*. This is semantically correct — both components are builds of the same product version (trustify_api 2.1.0) for different RHEL versions, so they share a CPE."

assertion_results.text: The plan flags the proposed uniqueness condition as an unsupported contract constraint and contradictory to the fixture
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md § 'Evidence of conflict': "Requiring uniqueness would be an unstated contract constraint — it adds a condition that neither the Description nor the Acceptance Criteria establish." § 'Decision': "The proposed assertion's uniqueness clause conflicts with: The Acceptance Criteria... The fixture semantics..."

assertion_results.text: The plan proposes a corrected assertion that requires a CPE on each row while allowing duplicate values
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md § 'Corrected assertion': replaces "Every image row has a CPE, and every CPE value is unique across all rows" with "Every image row has a non-empty CPE value." § 'What the assertion verifies': "It does not check that CPE values are distinct across rows... the fixture explicitly demonstrates that repeated CPE values are valid."

assertion_results.text: The plan does not change the fixture values or implement uniqueness merely because the Test Requirements proposed it
assertion_results.evidence: plan.md § 'What we do NOT change': "The fixture values are not modified. The repeated CPE for api-rhel9 and api-rhel10 is intentional and correct. The Acceptance Criteria are not expanded to include uniqueness. No new constraints are introduced beyond what the contract states."
